public.prompt: Complete the one configuration round-trip assignment: use the supplied PyYAML alias pd to safely serialize build_to_submit with safe_dump and reload that YAML with safe_load into configured_build. Do not alter the supplied fixtures, validation implementations, dependency configuration or execution helpers. Inspect their required checks and fatal dependencies. The supplied runner then writes/reloads configured_build, asserts the accepted, boundary and rejected fixture outcomes and retains the existing case evidence. Its result dictionary and exercise_case(case_id) interface are already supplied. These are bounded local in-process simulator executions, not hosted cloud runs. pd here aliases yaml; it is not pandas. All checks must still pass against the fixture inputs.
